items.title: Anthropic's Concord Cross-Motion: The Most Consequential Fair-Use Motion in AI Music Copyright

items.title: Bartz Fairness Hearing Rescheduled; Unsealed Objections Reach the Docket
items.summary: What was to be the day of reckoning for the largest copyright settlement in American history shifted under Judge Martínez-Olguín's April 8 order. We catalogue the unsealed objections — publisher favoritism, group-registration collapse, and statutory-damages adequacy — and what each may mean at the May 14 hearing.
